basis: Tonic pupil and tendon areflexia define an ocular autonomic and peripheral neurologic syndrome; a presumed infectious trigger does not establish ongoing infection.
Severe neurodevelopmental impairment and neonatal cholestasis define disease; high myopia in 1/2 supports ocular involvement. Mild proteinuria alone does not establish renal damage.
A developmental reading and language disorder classified under learning disability and hereditary neurologic disease.
Overgrowth arises in mediastinal adipose tissue, outside the listed axes; lung, airway, pleural or cardiovascular damage is not established.
Absent or atretic trachea defines disease; cardiac septal malformations are reported in 80-99%.
Oral and digital malformations define disease; ID occurs in 8/8. Hearing impairment occurs in 2/3; septal defect in 1/3 omitted under the four-axis cap.
Neurodegeneration with defining progressive external ophthalmoplegia; muscle wasting reflects denervation rather than a separate direct muscle disorder.
Defining open brain and spinal neural tube defects accompany cranial and vertebral nonclosure; cervical spina bifida occurs in 80-99%.
Destructive keratinizing lesion localized to the external ear.
Viral hemorrhagic disease with thrombocytopenia/coagulopathy; hepatic injury 80-99%, renal insufficiency 30-79%. Neurologic dysfunction 30-79% omitted under cap; rash is transient.
Crushing skeletal muscle injury with necrosis and acute renal failure defines the syndrome; shock alone does not establish direct cardiovascular damage.
Defining skull and acral skeletal anomalies with macrostomia; bifid nasal tip is dysmorphism without established airway dysfunction.
Pharyngeal disorders affect the upper airway, assigned to pulmonary; infection is not universal across this umbrella.
Inherited Alzheimer neurodegeneration with dementia, amyloid plaques and neurofibrillary tangles.
Malignancy of the fallopian tube is reproductive; no common direct damage to a covered organ is established.
Familial excess red blood cell production; thrombosis is a complication or separately diagnosed disease, not universal organ involvement.
Inherited lipid biosynthesis disorder with ichthyosis and severe neurologic impairment; joint contractures 2/4. High myopia 1/2 omitted under the four-axis cap.
Defining vascular malformations commonly involve skin; cerebral lesions and high-output heart failure occur in fewer than 30%.
Malignancy of ovarian steroid-producing endocrine cells, usually with androgen excess; endocrine function distinguishes it from purely reproductive tumors.
Chronic airway disease driven by an allergen-specific IgE-mediated immune response.
Overgrowth and acromegaloid skeletal features with defining cleft palate; the name does not establish growth hormone excess or another endocrine disorder.
An infectious abscess directly occupies and destroys liver tissue.
Structural narrowing of a carotid artery; ischemic stroke is a separately diagnosed complication rather than intrinsic universal brain involvement.
Inherited retinal cone and rod degeneration with progressive visual loss.
Postinfectious SARS-CoV-2 disease umbrella; no additional organ has established direct damage in at least 30% across its heterogeneous subtypes.
